scope: Bounded primary-source follow-up; no claim that unavailable or unpublished data do not exist

sources.name: Latimer2019 full-text Methods, Figure3 and attachments
sources.checked: Dynamic clamp recordings, output-nonlinearity Methods, Figure3 XML children, data-availability links and supplementary-media inventory
sources.finding: Two ON-parasol cells, 19s, 18/24 repeats; dynamic-clamp Eexc0mV/Einhib-90mV, 100us feedback. Figure3 provides a graphic, no attached raw V-spike file. Main listed supplementary file is the transparent-reporting DOCX
sources.limit: Fixed CBEM model Einhib-80mV is distinct from the recording dynamic-clamp condition

sources.name: Figshare9636854 v1 public six-cell data
sources.checked: Live public description, frozen six-file metadata and exact local Cell6 arrays
sources.finding: Description supplies six ON-parasol cells from Trong-Rieke2008, spike times, excitatory/inhibitory current trials and full-field stimuli. Cell6 has exactly ExcCurrents/ExcStm/InhCurrents/InhStm/SpikeStm/SpikeTimes/fn, with no voltage
sources.limit: Only Cell6 bytes inspected; other five files not downloaded or asserted field-identical. No paired dynamic-clamp voltage is advertised by the public description

sources.name: Cafaro and Rieke2013 original acquisition paper
sources.checked: Dynamic-clamp and recording Methods, data/link inventory
sources.finding: Current-clamp recordings, Eexc0/Einhib-90mV and100us feedback; common conductance scaling and optional bias current are experimental controls. Reported voltages have junction correction; peripheral cohort includes multiple macaque species
sources.limit: No downloadable raw voltage-spike deposit identified on inspected article. Exact Fig3 cell IDs, correction mapping, common scale and DC current values remain absent; no corrections or baseline targets transferred

sources.name: Author CBEM code and data directory
sources.checked: Current README and frozen repository tree/Data metadata; cached Python source blob identity
sources.finding: Data has example.mat and example_spatiotemporal.mat; README explicitly identifies the MATLAB example as simulated. Later Python uses90Hz/-53mV/1.67mV with voltage-valued history and binary sampling
sources.limit: Simulated code examples cannot provide independent animal V-spike evidence

sources.name: Publication CBEM code archive
sources.checked: Previously reviewed setup/simulation/fitting entries and frozen file tree; not redundantly re-fetched
sources.finding: Initialization c90, slope0.45/mV, b53*slope corresponds to beta2.222mV and dimensionless sph; this is distinct from paper/later Python beta1.67mV. Fitting entries modify leak terms
sources.limit: A versioned initialization is not a universal fitted parameter set or raw V-spike observation

sources.name: Rieke-Lab public repository index
sources.checked: All15 repository names/descriptions in public index
sources.finding: Index shows acquisition/protocol/calibration packages; no matching Cafaro2013 or LatimerFig3 raw-data deposit identified by this index
sources.limit: Metadata screening only; individual repository contents not exhaustively searched

sources.name: Prior conditional Cell6 fit and independent review
sources.checked: Existing calibration_decision, review_closure and exact source schema
sources.finding: Prior alpha+mu conditional attempt was rejected; alpha hit a declared bound, baseline remained high, and centered dynamic error worsened. Current-unit/time-origin gaps remained and heldout outcomes have been inspected
sources.limit: This is not an unused independent V-spike dataset, and alpha+mu is outside the current mu/mu+beta whitelist. No re-fit or bound expansion performed
